method.comparison: Recursive Git tree blob comparison by exact repository path and Git blob SHA.
method.byte_share_denominator: Sum of hc-brain blob sizes at the exact measured hc-brain head.
method.caveat: Git blob identity proves byte identity at the measured paths; it does not prove shared semantic authority, desired dependency direction, original copy lineage, or future maintenance benefit.
